chunks: Said one of the speakers: "I had a friend"

key_terms.قَائِلٌ: a speaker or one who speaks
key_terms.قَرِينٌ: a close companion, friend, or companion in misfortune

ai.seo_question: Who is the speaker in Surah Al-Muddaththir referring to when he mentions his 'friend' or 'companion'?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Muddaththir (74:11), the speaker from Hell recounts his close companion (qarīn), a term Shia exegetes often interpret as either a jinn tempter or a human peer, illustrating how mutual influence in sin leads to shared damnation. This verse underscores the profound impact of social bonds and spiritual companionship on one's ultimate fate, serving as a warning against choosing companions who divert one from divine guidance.
